column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-22 00:45): ka8-pmtp-w180k is in (records,
# cut 2 s after its 1800 s window: 27,577 tok/s/GPU, interactivity p90 74.4). The v0.5.22 C88 step fit puts one request on
# the busiest rank at ~1.05M tokens, so 180,000 under-weights requests (busiest / mean requests still 1.47 / 1.82).
# Next: the control (weight 0 = PR 210's token-only decode demand, new router) first, then weight 1,000,000; prefill with
# the EAGLE flags, flushed before each round, 1800 s windows (a cut round is measured over what it covered). Then the exact
# PR 210 repro (unmodified kit, image router, canonical 3600 s) on a fresh deployment.
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w0 CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=0 DURATION=1800
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w1m CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=1000000 DURATION=1800
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-repro CONC=88 ROUTER=image
